newsitem.title: FINLAND: Neste to shut three oil terminals by Oct.
newsitem.headline: Neste to shut three oil terminals by Oct.

text.p: Finnish oil, energy and petrochemicals group Neste Oy said in a statement on Friday it would close its commercial oil inland terminals in Oulu, Vaasa and Jyvaskyla in Finland by October this year.
"Continuing terminal operations...would have required large environment and maintenance investments," it said.
The company said it would buy substitute services from Shell and Esso.
The 20 employees on the terminals would be offered other jobs within the group.
